text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the gatehouse tablet freezing at Door 6 at Tansleigh Packaging?
reply_text:
I've answered Hollis in a thread on their message in #central-random. The ticket is #88412.

Tobias raised it in #central-team on 2 Jul 2025 as a Tier 2 escalation: the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 kept freezing on the BOL barcode scan. Hollis is a member of #central-team, so this is information they can already see. In the same thread Tobias confirmed the ticket is for Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel.

I also warned Hollis not to confuse it with #8841, a similar number for a different problem: West yard Door 2 double-booking on the dealer account.

text: One for the tracker: What is the ticket number for the Eastbank receiving-door import at Marrow Agrisupply? Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've answered Tobias in a thread on his message in #central-random. The ticket is PD-4821.

Hollis posted it in #central-team on 9 Jun 2026, saying the Eastbank receiving-door import was attached to that ticket. Tobias is a member of #central-team, so this is information he can already see. In the same post Hollis flagged a mismatch: the import file labelled the doors E1/E2, but the booking sheet used 01/02. I passed that along as it stood in June. I haven't seen anything since saying whether it was fixed.
